entities.summary: Holger Vitus Nødskov Rune is a Danish professional tennis player. He has been ranked as high as world No. 4 in singles by the ATP, making him the highest-ranked Danish man in the history of tennis. Rune has won five ATP Tour singles titles, including a Masters 1000 title at the 2022 Paris Masters, and has reached three major quarterfinals.
